major_concerns: Deterministic verifier coverage may miss semantic/vendor-specific failures (false sense of safety).
Sandbox/verifier mismatch: verifier-passed configs may behave differently in richer environments.
Repair loop risk: LLM may learn to game verifier (superficial fixes).
Task corpus construction and diversity not fully specified (risk of selection bias).
required_design_repairs: Use multiple verifiers and vendor-model variants (e.g., Batfish + vendor simulator) to broaden coverage.
Define and publish a representative task taxonomy and sampling procedure; include public templates and seeds.
Include human-curated ground-truth safety labels for a stratified sample to validate verifier decisions.
Add checks for verifier-gaming (e.g., adversarial counterexamples) and report repair-quality metrics beyond verifier pass (semantic checks).

major_concerns: Retrieval corpus coverage and alignment critically determine result validity; corpus curation is underspecified.
Automated hallucination detector risks false positives/negatives and may bias outcome measures.
Correlation/mediation claims between retrieval precision and verifier pass need careful causal framing.
required_design_repairs: Specify corpus assembly, provenance, and coverage metrics; release corpus or indexing snapshots for reproducibility.
Validate hallucination detector on a human-annotated verification set; report detector performance (precision/recall).
Predefine retrieval methods (dense/sparse), hyperparameters, and perform sensitivity analysis across retrievers; preregister mediation analysis plan.

major_concerns: Simulated agents and injected perturbations may not reflect operational complexity and may bias results toward contracts' effectiveness.
Schema/contract design choices can themselves induce performance artifacts (good schemas → good results).
Measurement of repair complexity and 'semantic' vs 'syntactic' failures is partly subjective without clear coding rules.
required_design_repairs: Provide a rationale and process for schema design; evaluate multiple realistic schema alternatives to avoid single-design bias.
Include runs seeded from real-world agent traces or publicly available logs if possible, or clearly characterize simulation limitations.
Define objective coding rules for repair-complexity classification and validate inter-annotator agreement on a sample.

major_concerns: Simulated operator behavior and calibrated decision-policy may not represent real human decisions and will drive key outcomes.
Latency model and organizational delays are underspecified and likely optimistic.
Threshold grid and calibration source (small public expert dataset) risk overfitting to proxy behavior.
required_design_repairs: Augment simulation with a small human-subjects pilot or use multiple published operator-behavior proxies; report provenance and limitations.
Model escalation latency with conservative ranges and sensitivity analysis; report trade-offs across realistic latency profiles.
Predefine and disclose the calibration dataset and include robustness checks across multiple simulated operator profiles.
